verses.text: Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you, O house of Israel.
verses.textZh: 以色列家啊，要聽耶和華對你們所說的話。

verses.text: Thus says the LORD, 'Do not learn the way of the nations, And do not be terrified by the signs of the heavens Although the nations are terrified by them;
verses.textZh: 耶和華如此說：你們不要效法列國的行為，也不要為天象驚惶，因列國為此事驚惶。

verses.text: For the customs of the peoples are delusion; Because it is wood cut from the forest, The work of the hands of a craftsman with a cutting tool.
verses.textZh: 眾民的風俗是虛空的；他們在樹林中用斧子砍伐一棵樹，匠人用手工造成偶像。

verses.text: 'They decorate [it] with silver and with gold; They fasten it with nails and with hammers So that it will not totter.
verses.textZh: 他們用金銀妝飾他，用釘子和錘子釘穩，使他不動搖。

verses.text: 'Like a scarecrow in a cucumber field are they, And they cannot speak; They must be carried, Because they cannot walk! Do not fear them, For they can do no harm, Nor can they do any good.'
verses.textZh: 他好像棕樹，是鏇成的，不能說話，不能行走，必須有人抬著。你們不要怕他；他不能降禍，也無力降福。

verses.text: There is none like You, O LORD; You are great, and great is Your name in might.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，沒有能比你的！你本為大，有大能大力的名。

verses.text: Who would not fear You, O King of the nations? Indeed it is Your due! For among all the wise men of the nations And in all their kingdoms, There is none like You.
verses.textZh: 萬國的王啊，誰不敬畏你？敬畏你本是合宜的；因為在列國的智慧人中，雖有政權的尊榮，也不能比你。

verses.text: But they are altogether stupid and foolish [In their] discipline of delusion-- their idol is wood!
verses.textZh: 他們盡都是畜類，是愚昧的。偶像的訓誨算甚麼呢？偶像不過是木頭。

verses.text: Beaten silver is brought from Tarshish, And gold from Uphaz, The work of a craftsman and of the hands of a goldsmith; Violet and purple are their clothing; They are all the work of skilled men.
verses.textZh: 有銀子打成片，是從他施帶來的，並有從烏法來的金子，都是匠人和銀匠的手工，又有藍色紫色料的衣服，都是巧匠的工作。

verses.text: But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and the everlasting King. At His wrath the earth quakes, And the nations cannot endure His indignation.
verses.textZh: 惟耶和華是真神，是活　神，是永遠的王。他一發怒，大地震動；他一惱恨，列國都擔當不起。

verses.text: Thus you shall say to them, 'The gods that did not make the heavens and the earth will perish from the earth and from under the heavens.'
verses.textZh: 你們要對他們如此說：不是那創造天地的神，必從地上從天下被除滅！）

verses.text: [It is] He who made the earth by His power, Who established the world by His wisdom; And by His understanding He has stretched out the heavens.
verses.textZh: 耶和華用能力創造大地，用智慧建立世界，用聰明鋪張穹蒼。

verses.text: When He utters His voice, [there is] a tumult of waters in the heavens, And He causes the clouds to ascend from the end of the earth; He makes lightning for the rain, And brings out the wind from His storehouses.
verses.textZh: 他一發聲，空中便有多水激動；他使雲霧從地極上騰；他造電隨雨而閃，從他府庫中帶出風來。

verses.text: Every man is stupid, devoid of knowledge; Every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols; For his molten images are deceitful, And there is no breath in them.
verses.textZh: 各人都成了畜類，毫無知識；各銀匠都因他雕刻的偶像羞愧。他所鑄的偶像本是虛假的，其中並無氣息，

verses.text: They are worthless, a work of mockery; In the time of their punishment they will perish.
verses.textZh: 都是虛無的，是迷惑人的工作；到追討的時候必被除滅。

verses.text: The portion of Jacob is not like these; For the Maker of all is He, And Israel is the tribe of His inheritance; The LORD of hosts is His name.
verses.textZh: 雅各的分不像這些，因他是造作萬有的主。以色列也是他產業的支派，萬軍之耶和華是他的名。

verses.text: Pick up your bundle from the ground, You who dwell under siege!
verses.textZh: 受圍困的人哪，當收拾你的財物，從國中帶出去。

verses.text: For thus says the LORD, 'Behold, I am slinging out the inhabitants of the land At this time, And will cause them distress, That they may be found.'
verses.textZh: 因為耶和華如此說：這時候，我必將此地的居民，好像用機弦甩出去，又必加害在他們身上，使他們覺悟。

verses.text: Woe is me, because of my injury! My wound is incurable. But I said, 'Truly this is a sickness, And I must bear it.'
verses.textZh: 民說：禍哉！我受損傷；我的傷痕極其重大。我卻說：這真是我的痛苦，必須忍受。

verses.text: My tent is destroyed, And all my ropes are broken; My sons have gone from me and are no more. There is no one to stretch out my tent again Or to set up my curtains.
verses.textZh: 我的帳棚毀壞；我的繩索折斷。我的兒女離我出去，沒有了。無人再支搭我的帳棚，掛起我的幔子。

verses.text: For the shepherds have become stupid And have not sought the LORD; Therefore they have not prospered, And all their flock is scattered.
verses.textZh: 因為牧人都成為畜類，沒有求問耶和華，所以不得順利；他們的羊群也都分散。

verses.text: The sound of a report! Behold, it comes-- A great commotion out of the land of the north-- To make the cities of Judah A desolation, a haunt of jackals.
verses.textZh: 有風聲！看哪，敵人來了！有大擾亂從北方出來，要使猶大城邑變為荒涼，成為野狗的住處。

verses.text: I know, O LORD, that a man's way is not in himself, Nor is it in a man who walks to direct his steps.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，我曉得人的道路不由自己，行路的人也不能定自己的腳步。

verses.text: Correct me, O LORD, but with justice; Not with Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.
verses.textZh: 耶和華啊，求你從寬懲治我，不要在你的怒中懲治我，恐怕使我歸於無有。

verses.text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not know You And on the families that do not call Your name; For they have devoured Jacob; They have devoured him and consumed him And have laid waste his habitation.
verses.textZh: 願你將忿怒傾在不認識你的列國中，和不求告你名的各族上；因為他們吞了雅各，不但吞了，而且滅絕，把他的住處變為荒場。
